- **`kernel/scheduler`** — Package scheduler is the DAG layer that sits *above* the first-party single-agent tool-loop (DECISIONS B0d, SPEC-02 §4).
- **`kernel/settings`** — Package settings is the file-backed config store behind the Config Center (M693): the NON-SECRET, operator-editable settings the daemon would otherwise only read from environment variables.
- **`kernel/standing`** — Package standing implements the standing-order model and store (SPEC-16 §4).
- **`kernel/state`** — Package state implements the first-class mutable state store (DECISIONS B0c).
- **`kernel/streamlimit`** — Package streamlimit caps the number of concurrent long-lived streams (SSE connections) a single client key may hold open at once.
- **`kernel/stt`** — Package stt is a minimal speech-to-text client for the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint, using net/http only — no dependency.
- **`kernel/tenant`** — Package tenant is the multi-tenant isolation foundation (ROADMAP P6-MULTI).
- **`kernel/tenantctx`** — Package tenantctx carries the identity of the tenant a run belongs to through the run's context.Context, so tools that behave differently per tenant (e.g.
- **`kernel/toolexec`** — Package toolexec retains the legacy tool execution compatibility entry points.
- **`kernel/toolreg`** — Package toolreg is the first-party tool registry (Phase 2.2).
- **`kernel/tunnel`** — Package tunnel exposes a local Agezt HTTP service (the Web UI or REST API) to the public internet by supervising an operator-chosen tunnel binary — cloudflared, ngrok, Tailscale, or any custom command.
- **`kernel/ulid`** — Package ulid implements ULID generation per DECISIONS B2 — 128-bit lexicographically sortable identifiers with a 48-bit millisecond timestamp prefix and 80-bit cryptographic randomness, encoded as 26 Crockford base32 characters.
- **`kernel/update`** — Package update implements Agezt's self-update mechanism.
- **`kernel/voicetool`** — Package voicetool provides the agent-facing voice tool: it lets a running agent HEAR (transcribe inbound audio to text) and SPEAK (synthesize a spoken reply).
- **`kernel/warden`** — Package warden is the process-isolation layer (SPEC-06 §2; TASKS P1-WARD-01).
- **`kernel/webhook`** — Package webhook is the outbound-webhook dispatcher (ROADMAP P7-API-02): it subscribes to the journal bus and POSTs matching events to operator-configured HTTP endpoints, so external systems learn what Agezt is doing in real time (a run completed, an approval is pending, the system halted).
- **`kernel/webui`** — Package webui serves the Agezt Web UI (SPEC-07, decision A4): a React 19 + Vite single-page app, built to static assets and go:embed-ded into the daemon (see embed.go) — one binary, no Node at runtime, and no Go dependency added.
